notes: Printed: 'Whenever you DRAW a card, you may pay {1}. When you do, you may tap or untap target creature.' Garruk, Savage Herald's +1 reveals the top card (a creature) and puts it into your hand; that is not a draw (CR 121.1), so the Kraken must not trigger: the opponent's Walker stays untapped and the {1} stays in the pool even though every offer would be answered.
